items.title: 'Doppelganger' may have been mistaken for MP Luke Gosling in bail caution

items.title: China Southern Airlines suspends direct Darwin to China route after one year

children.content: China Southern Airlines will suspend its direct flights between Darwin and Guangzhou, China after just one year operating in the NT. The airline's final scheduled flight to China will be on December 3.
